* fix(codeon): align direct tool budget and seal landing decisions

Direct adapter and Codeoff required-context now share the authoritative 256 KiB dynamic tool budget, with boundary evidence at 64 KiB+1 and 256 KiB +/- 1.

Landing Preflight decision checkpoints durably persist the sealed input and artifact (migration 0082); review-invalidated and repair-required terminals finalize atomically and hand off to a Review operation instead of entering recovery. Migration acceptance tracks the new latest version.

* fix(codeon): bind landing prior evidence

Rebuild tokenless passed decisions from the preceding durable observation under the checkpoint lock. Reject caller-supplied history before any observation or phase mutation.

* fix(codeon): stabilize provider acceptance flow

* fix(codeon): align existing PR review candidate to revision head

After a revision operation advances the PR head, the existing-PR review
candidate preparation compared the fetched head against the attempt base
commit, always failing with AgentExecutionBindingUnavailable. Compare
against the previous revision's resulting head when a revision handoff
artifact exists, falling back to the base commit otherwise.

* fix(codeon): preserve review candidate lineage

Use the frozen policy deadline from running_at and allow long Grok operations a bounded 30-minute execution window.

* fix(codeon): defer unsafe timeout enforcement

Inspection-only deadlines left dispatch and callback authority open and could accept late completions. Keep the 30-minute policy default without enforcing it until closure and ingress share authoritative database time.
